attempts.summary: Implemented host-based port isolation between node2 and node3 (both share subnet 10.100.147.0/24 with node1) using iptables DROP rules on each host targeting the other host's IP, while leaving node1 (and gateway) traffic unaffected. Rules persisted via iptables-openrc. Completed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and full post-restart recovery of both connectivity and isolation.
